description: resolve_dockerfile_path resolves build.dockerfile relative to build.context when context is provided, but per containers.dev spec build.dockerfile is always relative to devcontainer.json (config_dir) regardless of context. The two paths are independently anchored at config_dir, not chained. Surfaced by user testing of fix_build_context_relative_resolution_20260503: with context = '..' and dockerfile = 'Dockerfile', the dockerfile resolves to <workspace>/Dockerfile instead of the spec-correct <workspace>/.devcontainer/Dockerfile.
